# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Decision (2026-10-22)

Cadence: `daily`. Issue #31 ("weekly", May) is stale: the chain for decision key `report-cadence` is 0002 (weekly) -> 0014 (daily 06:00) -> 0023 (Accepted, in force). The ruling in force is ADR 0023, which also sets the time of day; implement from it, not from this note.

Reference
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0023
  Path           docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366

## Open items

- Mira asked for this task to be done today (2026-10-22). Not implemented yet: `SCHEDULE` in src/report_job.js is still `'weekly'` with a "see issue #31" comment; it needs to change to daily, and issue #31 should be closed or updated.
